model_comparison: one fit per model x scenario x graph family on all runs; AIC = 2k - 2LL, BIC = k ln(n) - 2LL, n = one-step transitions; delta = difference to the best model in the scenario x graph family; pseudo_r2 = McFadden 1 - LL / LL_null
behaviour: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold per scenario x graph family (group = run, stratified by graph type); fold assignment shared across models; each run scored once by the model fitted on the other folds
rollout: stochastic from round 0, seed 43 + 10000 * fold + run index
bootstrap: 1000 resamples over network realizations (graph type x seed; clusters of runs), 95% percentile CI
consensus_fidelity: 1 - mean over runs of the round-averaged |empirical - simulated| consensus fraction
final_state_mcc: pooled over agents; one-step prediction of the final round from the true previous state
